fato_historico: 1979: Swissair Flight 316 crashes at Ellinikon International Airport in Athens, Greece, killing 14.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel a gentle nudge to appreciate the fragile beauty of existence. Much like the wisdom gained from navigating unexpected storms, the stars suggest that clarity often follows moments of uncertainty. It is a good time to ground yourself in balance and nurture the peace within your heart, as harmony acts as your guiding light throughout the day.
frase_do_dia: Beauty blooms most brightly when we embrace the quiet strength of the present moment.
significado_numero: Represents the transformative power of experience and learning through unexpected shifts.
conselho: Prioritize your inner peace and remain gentle with yourself during any transition today.
